summary: Practise lot traceability, inspection records and certificate checks using ISPM 07, ISPM 12 and ISPM 23. Explore the course outline.
lede: Traceability training helps plant health inspectors, certification staff and records personnel connect consignment checks with lot and certificate evidence. Participants practise checking documents against goods, recording inspection findings and decisions, mapping lot histories, and retrieving supporting records for review. The course covers certification records, inspection procedures and certificate preparation, with electronic certificate data exchange introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who inspect plant consignments, prepare or verify phytosanitary certificate information, and maintain records that connect lots with their production and handling histories.
prerequisites: Foundation-level course. Familiarity with plant consignments or document handling is useful. No programming is required for the described record and certificate exercises.
